name: Happy Hues · Happy Hues

title.zh: Happy Hues · 对照界面角色与卡片实景选择配

description.zh: 看四张完整卡片的实际图标、文字与底色。 Happy Hues由Mackenzie Child制作，把策展色板应用到示例网页的背景、文字、按钮和插图，并按用途列出HEX色值。可对照界面用色角色与实际卡片效果取配色灵感，价格、制作源码、插图许可与商用范围仍未知。
description.en: Happy Hues by Mackenzie Child presents curated palettes in a real sample website, pairing role-labelled HEX values with their use in text, buttons, illustrations and cards. It is a contextual color reference; pricing, project source, artwork licensing and commercial scope remain unverified.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Happy Hues (https://www.happyhues.co/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看四张完整卡片的实际图标、文字与底色。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页的品牌与配色示例，再到同一色板页核对背景、标题、按钮、插图等十项用色角色及HEX和侧栏选项。下滚后，Hue、Tint、Shade、Tone四张完整卡片把颜色实际用于文字、图标与底色，便于设计师对照搭配。此次没有点击换色或复制控件，也未清点全站色板。价格、制作源码、许可与商用范围未知，术语说明只作原站内容参考。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
